Tommy Hilfiger Greenbelt Waist Pouch Sling Bag – Premium Style & Everyday Utility

The Tommy Hilfiger Greenbelt Waist Pouch Sling Bag is designed for modern, on-the-go lifestyles, offering a perfect combination of style, comfort, and functionality. Whether you’re traveling, commuting, or simply stepping out for a casual day, this premium waist pouch provides the ideal hands-free convenience. Its sleek and compact structure makes it exceptionally lightweight, while the iconic Tommy Hilfiger aesthetic elevates your everyday carry experience.

Crafted with durability in mind, the features high-quality materials, smooth zippers, and a comfortable adjustable strap that adapts easily to different wearing styles. You can use it as a waist pouch, belt bag, crossbody sling, or travel organizer—making it versatile for multiple occasions. With a practical 3 Ltr capacity and ergonomic design, this pouch holds your essentials like mobile phone, cards, wallet, passport, keys, earbuds, and other daily items with ease.

Perfect Dimensions & Lightweight Build

The thoughtfully engineered size of L 36cm x W 6.5cm x H 13.5cm ensures optimal storage without feeling bulky. Weighing only 146 gm, the bag is incredibly comfortable for long hours, making it suitable for travel, shopping, trekking, jogging, cycling, or airport transit.

Why Choose?

With rising demand for compact yet stylish travel accessories, this waist pouch stands out for its superior build quality and timeless design. The bold branding and minimalistic finish make it ideal for gifting, corporate kits, outdoor activities, and everyday use. Whether you prefer a sporty look or a sleek casual style, this seamlessly fits your fashion goals.
